Invocta Screen Control allows the AI assistant to read screen content and perform actions on your behalf. This enables features like:

• Reading what's on your screen
• Tapping buttons and links
• Typing text into fields
• Scrolling through content
• Navigating between apps

Your privacy is important - Invocta only accesses the screen when you ask it to perform an action.
